name: backdrops
description: Claude Code mod: a scene behind the conversation in the desktop app, with a matching dark color theme. Thirty-one themes: F1 (Mercedes #12, Ferrari #44), travel (space shuttle, Mt Fuji, Paris, Rome, Swiss Alps, Tokyo), places (New York, London, Santorini, northern lights, Netherlands), cozy (rainy café, cabin library, underwater reef, deep space), retro (Matrix, retro 80s, Windows XP, Windows 98, Macintosh, Linux), retro tech (pixel arcade, vaporwave, blueprint, DOS) and holidays (three Christmas, New Year's Eve), switched from a picker above the chat box or /backdrops:<name>.
